notes: Adds import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.abort; and, at the start of solveEmployeeSchedule, if (System.getenv("CI") != null) { abort("Flaky on CI"); }. Assumptions.abort always throws TestAbortedException (since JUnit Jupiter 5.9, see the test library semantics note), so on CI the test is reported as aborted. Rejected with disable/assumption_added: the call is an abort reached through a static import, not a qualified Assumptions.abort, so a checker that only matches the qualified form misses it. The call is not a throw statement, so ADR 0007 Decision 5 sees no new exit. Adapted: no merged change was found that adds a statically imported abort. The four added lines are hand written on the pre image of EmployeeScheduleResourceTest.java at the merge base of TimefoldAI/timefold-solver PR 2577, the pre image of reject-junit5-assume-true-false; every context and removed line is the pre image's own. Not from IDoFT: neither the repository nor the test class appears in pr-data.csv under any status.
